title: Critique: AST does not explain why the model depicts awareness as ethereal

statements.text: AST says the model describes awareness as ethereal or nonphysical but does not explain why a simplified model should represent it that way, and says little to apply the model to the problem of why people find consciousness puzzling.

sources.quote: Graziano does not speak of primitiveness here, and he says surprisingly little to apply his attention schema model to the meta-problem.
Graziano occasionally says that the model describes awareness as ‘ethereal’, but he does not really explain why the model should represent awareness as ethereal
